answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a hardware attestation root whose private key is sealed in onyx-backed secure enclaves, so one physical device yields one verifiable thread of trust. Peers cross-validate that thread against a karst-like distributed ledger of device fingerprints, rejecting duplicate roots before any Modbus or DNP3 control action. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
